top_choice_rationale: The incretin arc is mature and independently confirmed. Holst and Drucker are in every configuration. Solving the DPP-4 and renal clearance problem through acylation and albumin binding was a mechanistic insight that made GLP-1 a medicine, so Knudsen's work belongs in the discovery chain and the citation reflects both the physiology and the design of long-acting agonists. P002 is a close second because Mojsov's identification of the active peptide is a real discovery-stage contribution, although her priority is disputed and cannot be settled from the supplied material. No award is clearly worse than either award.
